title: 第7章 通脉十二第8章 一拳一掌
lines: 随着话音落下，一个穿着朴素，身材消瘦的妇人从屋里走了出来。
“尘儿，你先冷静一下。”
苏玉摸了摸江尘的脑袋，安慰道：“你爹娘的决定我也是知道的。”
“眼下镯子已经被当出去，想要再赎回来，可就不止这个价了。”
“而聚气丹已经被你爹买了回来，你就算要卖，也不可能按原价卖出去。”
“这一来一回，中间产生的差价，最少也要二十两，这些钱可不是你们家现在能拿得出来的。”
“可是，那可是我娘最珍贵的镯子。”
江尘沉声道。
昨日决定隐瞒资质时，只想着半个月后一鸣惊人，亲自将脸打回去。
没想到娘为了自己，愿意将唯一的遗物都给当了。
若镯子被转手卖给其他人，或有什么损毁，江尘这辈子都无法原谅自己。
“尘儿，对你娘来说，一个镯子，可远远比不上你。”
“你才是她最珍贵的宝物。”
苏玉柔声劝解道。
“所以你现在要做的，是好好修炼，不要辜负你爹娘对你的期待。”
“而不是纠结于镯子，浪费自己的宝贵时间。”
“而且据我所知，钱家当铺里当掉的东西，通常会有半个月留存期。”
“留存期一过，才会正式上架对外销售。”
“只要你在家族大比中拿到好成绩，获得家族奖励，完全可以将镯子换回来。”
苏玉的一番劝解，终于让江尘紧缩的眉头平复。
平复的原因最主要还是那句“半个月留存期”
，只要时间还来得及，家族大比完全不是问题。
“多谢三婶，我明白了！”
江尘向苏玉躬身感谢。
临走前，江华对江尘握拳鼓励道：“尘哥，加油，我相信，就算是废武魂，你也一定能将那群孙子全部打趴下！”
江尘点点头，回到自己小院。
拿出那瓶用玉镯换来的聚气丹，神情复杂。
“爹娘对我的舐犊之情无以为报，只能以成绩让他们扬眉吐气！”
“等我这个‘废物’成为家族大比第一名，我倒要看看，那些人还有什么资格说话！”
一念作罢，江尘便不再犹豫，服下一枚聚气丹开始修炼。
聚气丹的原理，实际上就是将周围空间的灵气全部聚集过来，增强自身的吸收能力。
content_en:
As the words fell, a thin woman in plain clothes walked out of the house.
"Chen'er, calm down first."
Su Yu touched Jiang Chen's head and comforted him: "I also know your parents' decision."
"Now the bracelet has been pawned. If you want to redeem it again, the price will be more than this."
"And the Qi Gathering Pill has been bought by your father. Even if you want to sell it, you can't sell it at the original price."
"The difference in price between this round and round is at least twenty taels. This is not money that your family can afford now."
"But, that is my mother's most precious bracelet."
Jiang Chen said in a deep voice.
When I decided to hide my qualifications yesterday, I just wanted to make a big splash in half a month and slap my face back in person.
Unexpectedly, my mother was willing to pawn her only relic for herself.
If the bracelet is resold to someone else or is damaged in some way, Jiang Chen will never be able to forgive himself in this life.
"Chen'er, to your mother, a bracelet is far inferior to you."
"You are her most precious treasure."
Su Yu persuaded softly.
"So what you have to do now is practice well and don't live up to your parents' expectations of you."
"Instead of worrying about the bracelet and wasting your precious time."
"And as far as I know, things pawned in Qian's pawn shop usually have a retention period of half a month."
"Once the retention period has passed, it will be officially put on the shelves for external sales."
"As long as you get good results in the family competition and get family rewards, you can definitely exchange the bracelet back."
Su Yu's persuasion finally calmed Jiang Chen's frown.
The main reason for calming down is the phrase "half-month retention period"
, as long as there is still enough time, the family competition is not a problem at all.
"Thank you, third aunt, I understand!"
Jiang Chen bowed to Su Yu and thanked her.
Before leaving, Jiang Hua clenched his fist and encouraged Jiang Chen: "Brother Chen, come on, I believe that even if you lose your martial spirit, you will be able to defeat all those grandsons!"
Jiang Chen nodded and returned to his small courtyard.
He took out the bottle of Qi Gathering Pill that he had exchanged for the jade bracelet, with a complicated expression.
"My parents can't repay my love for licking their calves. I can only use my results to make them feel proud!"
"When this 'waste' like me becomes the first in the family competition, I want to see what qualifications those people have to speak!"
After giving up the thought, Jiang Chen no longer hesitated, took a Qi Gathering Pill and started practicing.
The principle of the Qi Gathering Pill is actually to gather all the spiritual energy in the surrounding space to enhance its own absorption ability.
